description: This file contains functions for parsing various request types and forming responses related to WDMP (Wireless Device Management Protocol). It includes request parsing for get, set, attribute set, test-and-set, row operations, and response formatting functions for different response types, along with a status code mapping utility.

methods.name: parse_get_request
methods.description: Parses a JSON request to extract get parameters, including OIDs or names, and attributes like notify.

methods.name: parse_set_request
methods.description: Parses a JSON request to extract set parameters, including OIDs or names, values, and data types.

methods.name: parse_set_attr_request
methods.description: Parses a JSON request to set attributes, particularly notification attributes.

methods.name: parse_test_and_set_request
methods.description: Parses a JSON request for test-and-set operations, including old and new CIDs, sync CMC, and parameters.

methods.name: parse_replace_rows_request
methods.description: Parses a JSON request to replace multiple rows in a table, extracting row data.

methods.name: parse_add_row_request
methods.description: Parses a JSON request to add a new row to a table.

methods.name: parse_delete_row_request
methods.description: Parses a JSON request to delete a specific row from a table.

methods.name: wdmp_form_get_response
methods.description: Forms a JSON response for a get request, including parameters, values, and status messages.

methods.name: wdmp_form_get_attr_response
methods.description: Forms a JSON response for get attribute requests, including notification attributes.

methods.name: wdmp_form_set_response
methods.description: Forms a JSON response for set requests, including status messages.

methods.name: wdmp_form_table_response
methods.description: Forms a JSON response for table row operations, including new row object and status.

methods.name: wdmp_form_test_and_set_response
methods.description: Forms a JSON response for test-and-set operations, including parameters and status.

methods.name: mapWdmpStatusToStatusMessage
methods.description: Maps WDMP status codes to human-readable status messages.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Determines overall response status code based on individual parameter statuses.
